Title: Warning! Do NOT Trade with Frank Alejano! Warning!

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
Just a little note to let everybody know that fra...@owlnet.rice.edu
(Frank Alejano) is either a thief or inept beyond use. I have been
waiting twenty-five (25) days for his end of a rares trade to arrive.

He's already replied that he has received my end of the trade, but "oops"
he mailed his end to his own address. That was fifteen days ago (when
he claims to have remailed with the proper address.

I no longer get e-mail responses from him.

Use this information if you wish.
Thanks for the time.
L. Scott
